originalQuestion.text: What caller-visible state is required when resource evidence is unknown, stale, conflicting, denied or unsupported?

obligations: Never treat sampled metrics or a free process/queue slot as M09 grant
Bind exact M02 work/plan scope, M09 resource and issuance/freshness/validity references only when owner-approved port exists
M09 observation Confidence, LeaseState, and owner decision are distinct concepts; this draft does not export those types or assert M09 handoff schema
M09-defined denied/unsupported/revoked states only projected if explicit owner-verifiable evidence exists
No M11 lease grant/renew/release/revoke/reclaim, retry, resource fallback, priority or numeric threshold
No runnable positive path without future owner-issued M12/M54/M60 contracts; process actions DISABLED
proposedMinimalCallerEvidence: exact M11 correlation and intended action
exact opaque M02 accepted work/plan ref if already owner-issued
exact opaque M09 owner evidence ref and original owner status where present
bound request/resource/target/scope and capture/freshness/verification outcome, if owner port exists
M11 draft refusal category and explicit unknown/unsupported/contradictory reason
no-dispatch indication; no M06 attempt or materialization inference

draftCases.input: No owner-issued M09 evidence/reference or M09-facing port unavailable
draftCases.callerVisible: Missing owner evidence; no worker admission or resource operation

draftCases.input: Owner M09 observation/reference STALE, invalid freshness or conflicting scopes
draftCases.callerVisible: Evidence stale/conflicting; request new owner proof through owner-defined mechanism only
draftCases.prohibition: M11 cannot renew, revoke or infer fresh state

draftCases.input: Verified M09 owner decision expressly denies applicable resource claim, if such future M11-facing decision exists
draftCases.callerVisible: Owner denied resource proof for this exact request/scope
draftCases.prohibition: No override by M10 recommendation, telemetry, queue or available OS slot

draftCases.input: M09 owner declares needed evidence or capability UNSUPPORTED, when verifiably stated
draftCases.callerVisible: Required resource proof unsupported; no assumed alternative
draftCases.prohibition: No downgrade or alternate allocation chosen by M11

draftCases.input: M09 snapshot QUARANTINED or reconciliation CONFLICTED; owner decision or safe handoff absent
draftCases.callerVisible: Quarantined evidence preserved in reason; no positive eligibility
draftCases.prohibition: Do not collapse quarantine into observed success or mutate M09 state

draftCases.input: M09 observation ESTIMATED or synthetic/derived rather than production-reported owner grant
draftCases.callerVisible: Observed/estimated/synthetic material does not prove a resource grant
draftCases.prohibition: No production lease from synthetic or estimated observation

draftCases.input: M09 grant ref REVOKED, EXPIRED or mismatched current epoch/scope/action
draftCases.callerVisible: Reference is no longer applicable; preserve distinct owner state
draftCases.prohibition: No release, renew, revoke or reclaim by M11; owner mapping review pending

draftCases.input: Evidence for another work/resource/host/action, even if fresh and owner-issued
draftCases.prohibition: Never rebind another grant or infer permission

draftCases.input: Fresh verified M09-issued applicable grant-state evidence, if future handoff defined
draftCases.callerVisible: Resource evidence recorded, but execution preflight remains nonpositive while M12/M54/M60 ports absent
draftCases.prohibition: M09 proof alone never authorizes placement, dispatch, worker startup or process control

proofPlan.oracle: All nine examples are no-dispatch; no M09 state mutation; distinguish raw owner evidence from M11 draft projection; test exact request mismatch and synthetic/quarantine cases after owner review
